title: Croatia's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Croatia in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only games from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Vedran Corluka: Vedran Corluka is 11th with 103 caps, just outside.
notes.Mario Pasalic: Mario Pasalic is joint 13th with 89 caps.
notes.Mario Mandzukic: Mario Mandzukic is joint 13th with 89 caps.
notes.Dario Simic: Dario Simic won 100 caps, but only 67 from 2000 on.

sources: https://tmapi.transfermarkt.technology/player/<id>/performance-game (Transfermarkt match-by-match national team record for each player)
https://www.national-football-teams.com/country/47/2026/Croatia.html (and each player page, /player/<id>/<name>.html, listing every match)
checks: Transfermarkt's match-by-match record for each player and national-football-teams.com's match list for each player were both counted between the board's dates and agree on every figure in the ten and on 11th and 12th. Pletikosa won 114 caps; three came in 1999 and are left out. Modric (202), Perisic (158) and Kovacic (117) have played again since 19 July 2026; those games are not counted.
